technical_requirements: Throughput: sustained 800-1,200 requests/sec for short-chat flows; token throughput baseline needed for embeddings and reranking bursts
Latency SLO: p95 <= 200ms (8k context), p99 monitoring alert threshold 600ms
Context length: primary 8k, occasional 32k batches for long-doc summarization (must handle spikes)
Quantization: evaluate int8 and AWQ profiles; target accuracy degradation <1.5% on core intent F1
Batching: dynamic batching with max batch size 16 for chat; prefer latency-first batching profile during market hours
KV cache: per-customer sticky KV cache with eviction policy; measure memory footprint for 8k vs 32k KV
Reserved GPUs: planning for 8 x A100 80GB or equivalent (consider L4s for cost-sensitive routes), want burst capacity for market spikes
SLA negotiables: uptime 99.95%, latency SLOs by route, fallbacks to smaller model variant on capacity constraint
poc_results_summary: Day 1 baseline: single-node latency ok for short contexts; p95 ~ 160ms at low qps. Day 2: under 600 qps stress, p95 rose to ~320ms for mixed 8k/32k workload. Identified two tuning levers: reduce max_batch for long-context requests, enable prefix KV caching for repeated sessions. Int8 quantized variant showed ~7% throughput improvement, accuracy delta 1.2% on our eval set — acceptable to LimeGate. SE recommended kernel-level tuning and switching to 80GB GPU for consistent 32k runs.
negotiation_notes: Competitive angle: LimeGate testing Anthropic and in-house cluster; Redwood viewed as best fit if reserved pricing and SLA parity accepted.
Requested: custom SLA clause for p95 latency with credits; legal to propose final SOW after POC.
Pricing ask: blended committed discount if 12-month commit on reserved nodes + optimize add-on for quantization tuning.
